description: This Java class 'UtilPlist' provides utilities for reading and writing property list (plist) data structures in both XML and traditional formats, including methods to serialize maps and lists to plist representations. It appears to be part of the Apache OFBiz project, specifically for handling plist files used in macOS/iOS environments.

classes.name: UtilPlist
classes.description: Utility class for reading and writing property list (plist) data structures in XML and traditional formats.

methods.name: writePlistFile
methods.description: Writes a map representing model information into a plist file in either XML or traditional format at the specified location.
